signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own value and business-viability risk for your product area: who it serves, what the problem costs them today, and what solving it is worth to Drata
Run continuous discovery across customer calls, Productboard insights, support signals and usage data, and turn it into a short, ranked list of evidence-backed problem statements
Set outcome-based goals (baseline, target, date and what's out of scope) jointly with your engineering manager
Sequence the path to those goals, make trade-offs explicit, and name the biggest risk and your fallback before anyone asks
Communicate the plan at three levels: to your team, to GTM and Customer Success partners, and to executives, leading with the customer impact
Manage a portfolio of products and/or capabilities and build resource investment allocation plans grounded in data and research
Define roadmap and requirements to solve the biggest customer problems across one or multiple product lines
Define MVP experiences and quickly learn and iterate based on feedback
Form hypothesis and run experiments using lean methodologies
Partner closely with engineering and design teams to define, build, and maintain products/features which are critical to growth and retention
